purpose: Seal the full N192/N576 numerical contract that exactly preserves an independent CF4 posterior parent while retaining independent fine null-space modes.

contract.restriction: R folds each N192 output-Nyquist equivalence class with 1/sqrt(2**r) normalization.
contract.prolongation: x=z+R*(y-Rz), where y is the N192 parent and z is independent N576 white noise.

interpretation.parent_preservation: Every tested IID or sealed CF4 N192 field, including parents3193 and 3429, is recovered after N576 prolongation to float32 numerical precision with all output-Nyquist modes included.
interpretation.fine_diversity: Two independent N576 draws conditioned on the identical parent3429 differ at the expected near-sqrt(2) field RMS while both restrict back to the same N192 field.
interpretation.scientific_scope: The numerical contract removes the old projection ambiguity and makes an independent-parent hierarchy possible. It does not by itself define the Local-Group likelihood, peak evidence correction, parent weights, or any candidate selection.

next: Define the proposal state as parent index, fine null-space seed, peak-noise seed, geometry seed, and midpoint seed.
Use all 256 sealed CF4 posterior parents with an explicitly uniform or stratified parent proposal.
Condition peak information only in ker(R), so every generated field restricts exactly to its parent.
Include normalized peak marginal evidence and midpoint target/proposal density in the importance weight.
Run a cheap all-parent evidence/ESS feasibility audit before generating N576 candidates or running PM.
